item.title: Iranian sea trade blocked as six ships forced to turn back, U.S. military says
item.summary: A U.S. blockade in effect since Monday has completely cut off Iran’s sea trade, the U.S. military said after six merchant ships were prevented from leaving Iranian ports.

item.title: U.S. sends thousands more troops to Mideast as Trump seeks to squeeze Iran
item.summary: The infusion of firepower coincides with the administration’s maritime blockade against the regime in Tehran and as mediators urge both sides to extend their ceasefire.

item.title: Trump says China has agreed not to send weapons to Iran
item.summary: The president made the claim, which Beijing has yet to confirm, amid anger in China that its vessels could be caught up in a U.S. blockade targeting Iranian ports.

item.title: Trump says Iran talks may resume this week, but opposes enrichment compromise
item.summary: The lead U.S. negotiator, Vice President JD Vance, has sought a moratorium on uranium enrichment of at least 20 years. Tehran’s offer would last up to five.

item.title: Lebanese, Israeli diplomats hold rare face-to-face meeting in Washington
item.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio hosted ambassadors from the two neighboring states in what was described as a working group aimed at reaching a ceasefire.

item.title: How geography powers Iran’s grip on the Strait of Hormuz, despite U.S. blockade
item.summary: Even with a U.S. blockage, geography gives Iran an edge in the Strait of Hormuz, shaping control of a vital global chokepoint.

item.title: Trump administration pushes nations to sign ‘trade over aid’ declaration
item.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio called it an opportunity to use the U.N. system to “promote America First values,” according to a cable reviewed by The Post.

item.title: House defies Trump on immigration with move to shield Haitians
item.summary: The vote to advance a bill extending protections for Haitians marks the first time Republican lawmakers have voted this term to oppose Trump’s immigration policy.

item.title: World’s oldest gorilla, known for her dignified manner, turns 69
item.summary: Legend has it that Fatou was brought from Africa to France in the late 1950s by a sailor who then traded her to settle a bar bill.
